args.message: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its own docstring and FIN-212, which requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- Test cases verified: `2.675 -> 2.68` (rounds up, 7 is odd) and `2.665 -> 2.66` (stays, 6 is even).

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
